definitions.gloss: net profit; net income; bottom line
definitions.explanation: The profit remaining after all expenses, taxes, and costs have been deducted from total revenue. A fundamental term in business and accounting.

examples.japanese: {純利益|じゅんりえき}が{増|ふ}えた。
{今期|こんき}の{純利益|じゅんりえき}は{過去最高|かこさいこう}だった。
examples.english: This term's net profit was the highest ever.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}は{伸|の}びたが、{原材料費|げんざいりょうひ}の{高騰|こうとう}で{純利益|じゅんりえき}は{減少|げんしょう}した。
examples.english: Sales grew, but net profit decreased due to rising raw material costs.

notes: Composed of {純|じゅん} (net, pure) + {利益|りえき} (profit). Abbreviated as {純益|じゅんえき}. Contrast with {粗利益|あらりえき} or {売上総利益|うりあげそうりえき} (gross profit — before deducting operating expenses) and {営業利益|えいぎょうりえき} (operating profit — before deducting taxes and non-operating items). Common collocations: {純利益|じゅんりえき}が{増加|ぞうか}する (net profit increases), {純利益|じゅんりえき}を{計上|けいじょう}する (to post net profit).
